description: This Java class provides factory methods for creating and parsing Acknowledgements objects related to 'Thing' entities within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for constructing acknowledgements from collections, entity IDs, headers, and JSON representations.

classes.name: ThingAcknowledgementsFactory
classes.description: A final utility class providing static factory methods for creating and parsing Acknowledgements related to 'Thing' entities.

methods.name: newAcknowledgements
methods.description: Creates an Acknowledgements instance from a collection of acknowledgements and headers.

methods.name: newAcknowledgements
methods.description: Creates an Acknowledgements instance from an entity ID, acknowledgements collection, status code, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Parses an Acknowledgements instance from a JSON object.
